collision_support.method: collision-support-v2: Geometry/Roadway/View-Geometry support; 0..0.08m below; 12cm footprint; 50cm vertical clearance against Geometry/Roadway only (View-Geometry occluder boxes never block); building roof and eight wall rays; stock proxy tables only; proxy marker faces excluded; no visual fallback

hc_floor_generation.method: hc-floor-v1: native stock points on building Geometry/Roadway floors seed a 0.50m walk lattice; every cell needs a clear standing body (0.22m radius, 1.8m) and a swept same-storey corridor with sampled floor from a reached neighbour (closed doors block); points avoid stock spawn discs (stock range + 0.5m), 1.0m of door leaves and stair steps; wall-side cells first, farthest-point spacing 1.5m, one point per 8m2 reached (2..12); collision support/enclosure gate before admission; optional props block bodies and points
